CI/CD build system: daily challenge, 2027-02-22

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-22: CI/CD build system. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Every time a developer saves code to the shared repository, you build and test it. Thousands of developers do this all day, and release day brings a rush. Builds must start quickly, but idle build machines cost real money.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
